after.test/documents_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule DocumentsTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "bob cannot delete alice's document" do
    rows = %{1 => %{owner: :alice}}
    {:ok, store} = Agent.start_link(fn -> rows end)
    assert {:error, :unauthorized} = Documents.delete(store, 1, :bob)
    assert Agent.get(store, & &1) == rows
  end
end
